title: Old Railway Bridge
note: Four dark riveted through-lattice spans cross the Sava on pale masonry piers. The source restores the photographed railway deck, paired rails and timber sleepers, the double diagonals, portal posts and overhead and underside bracing. An absolute 65 m datum and submerged foundations fit the standard viewer river and embankments. The placement uses the original signed railway alignment and preserves both neighboring bridges and native river terrain. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.
